blocks.prompt: 7 (a) A comet orbits the Sun in an elliptical path such that its position (in AU) at time \(t\) (in years) is described by \(x = 2\cos t, y = \sin t\). Write the position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan dono coordinates pehle se diye hue hain; position vector bas inhein ek vector mein jorta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x = 2\cos t\) aur \(y = \sin t\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Plan: \(x\) ko \(\hat{i}\) ke saath aur \(y\) ko \(\hat{j}\) ke saath likho, phir check karo ke yeh waqai ellipse banata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = 2\cos t\), \(y = \sin t\).
Maloom karna: \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\,\hat{i} + y(t)\,\hat{j}\), yani 11.1.3 wali component form.

Position vector
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: har coordinate apne axis wale unit vector ke saath likha jata hai: \(x\) ke saath \(\hat{i}\), \(y\) ke saath \(\hat{j}\). Yaad rahe ke yahan \(t\) years mein hai aur faasla AU mein, is liye aage velocity ki unit AU per year hogi.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) aur \(y\) ko ulat kar \(\sin t\,\hat{i} + 2\cos t\,\hat{j}\) likh dena ghalat hai; jo component jis axis ka hai wohi us ke unit vector ke saath jayega.

Tasdeeq: path ellipse hai
\[\left(\dfrac{x}{2}\right)^{2} + y^{2} = \cos^{2}t + \sin^{2}t = 1\]
\[\dfrac{x^{2}}{4} + y^{2} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\frac{x}{2} = \cos t\) aur \(y = \sin t\), aur \(\cos^{2}t + \sin^{2}t = 1\). Yeh ellipse (lamba gol, ande jaisa) hai jo \(x\)-axis par 2 tak aur \(y\)-axis par 1 tak jata hai, bilkul jaisa sawal kehta hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j}\) (AU); is ka path ellipse \(\frac{x^{2}}{4} + y^{2} = 1\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (b) A comet orbits the Sun in an elliptical path such that its position (in AU) at time \(t\) (in years) is described by \(x = 2\cos t, y = \sin t\). Find the velocity and speed at \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Velocity position ka derivative hai aur speed us ki lambai.
Diya kya hai? Part (a) ka \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity aur speed.
Plan: differentiate, \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakho, phir lambai nikalo aur dekho comet kahan hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j}\).
Maloom karna: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity aur speed.
Tareeqa: \(\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{r}'\) aur speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\).

Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = -2\sin t\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j}\]
\[\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = -2\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2}\,\hat{i} + \cos\tfrac{\pi}{2}\,\hat{j}\]
\[= -2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(2\cos t\) ka derivative \(-2\sin t\) aur \(\sin t\) ka \(\cos t\). Phir \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) aur \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\).

Speed
\[\left|\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\right| = \sqrt{(-2)^{2} + 0^{2}} = 2\]
Kyun: velocity ki lambai; \((-2)^{2} = 4\), to \(\sqrt{4} = 2\). Speed hamesha positive hoti hai, chahe velocity ka component negative ho.

Matlab
Pehle position dekhte hain: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par comet \(\mathbf{r} = 0\,\hat{i} + \hat{j}\), yani ellipse ki sab se oonchi jagah \((0, 1)\) par hai, aur negative \(x\) (baayen) ki taraf 2 AU per year se ja raha hai. Tasdeeq: velocity \(-2\,\hat{i}\) bilkul ufuqi (horizontal) hai, aur ellipse ki choti par tangent bhi ufuqi hi hota hai. AU (astronomical unit) Zameen aur Sooraj ka ausat faasla hai. Khud sochiye: \(t = 0\) par comet kahan hai aur kis taraf ja raha hai? Jawab: \(\mathbf{r}(0) = 2\,\hat{i}\), yani point \((2, 0)\), aur \(\mathbf{v}(0) = 0\,\hat{i} + \hat{j}\), yani seedha upar 1 AU per year. Is se pata chalta hai ke comet anticlockwise ghoom raha hai aur kinaron par dheema, choti par tez hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (c) A comet orbits the Sun in an elliptical path such that its position (in AU) at time \(t\) (in years) is described by \(x = 2\cos t, y = \sin t\). Show that the acceleration vector always points toward the origin.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'show that' (saabit karo) wala sawal hai, is liye sirf ek lamhe par nahin, har \(t\) ke liye dikhana hai.
Diya kya hai? Part (b) ki velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t) = -2\sin t\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j}\).
Saabit kya karna hai? Acceleration hamesha origin ki taraf hai.
Rule: agar koi vector \(\mathbf{r}\) ka negative multiple ho to woh \(\mathbf{r}\) ki ulti simt mein hota hai.
Plan: \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) nikalo aur use \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ki shakal mein likho.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (b) se \(\mathbf{v}(t) = -2\sin t\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j}\).
Saabit karna: har \(t\) par \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) origin ki taraf hai.
Tareeqa: \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke nateeja \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ki shakal mein likhenge.

Acceleration
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = \mathbf{v}'(t) = -2\cos t\,\hat{i} - \sin t\,\hat{j}\]
\[= -\left(2\cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j}\right)\]
\[= -\mathbf{r}(t)\]
Kyun: \(-2\sin t\) ka derivative \(-2\cos t\), aur \(\cos t\) ka \(-\sin t\). Phir dono terms se \(-1\) common nikala to bracket ke andar bilkul \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) aa gaya.
Dhyan dein: sirf \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par check kar ke 'saabit' likh dena kaafi nahin; general \(t\) par dikhana zaroori hai.

Simt
\(\mathbf{r}(t)\) origin \(O\) se comet ki taraf ishara karta hai, to \(-\mathbf{r}(t)\) comet se wapas \(O\) ki taraf. Kyunke har \(t\) ke liye \(\mathbf{a}(t) = (-1)\mathbf{r}(t)\), acceleration hamesha origin ki taraf hai.
Kyun: kisi vector ko negative number se multiply karein to us ki simt ulat jati hai. Jaise rassi se bandhi ghoomti gend ko rassi hamesha markaz ki taraf kheenchti hai.

Tasdeeq
Figure dekhiye: ellipse ke har point par sabz (green) teer seedha \(O\) ki taraf hai. Ek point par check bhi kar lein: \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\mathbf{r} = \hat{j}\) aur \(\mathbf{a} = -\hat{j}\), yani \((0, 1)\) se seedha neeche \(O\) ki taraf. Yeh bhi ghaur kijiye ke acceleration ki lambai \(|\mathbf{a}| = |\mathbf{r}|\) hai, to comet jab door hota hai (ellipse ke siron par) tab kheench zyada aur jab qareeb (choti par) tab kam hai, is aasaan model mein. (Hamari taraf se note: is aasaan model mein kheenchne wala markaz ellipse ka centre \(O\) hai; asli comet ke liye Sooraj ellipse ke focus par hota hai, lekin tareeqa yahi rehta hai.)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: har \(t\) ke liye \(\mathbf{a}(t) = -\mathbf{r}(t)\), jo position vector ki ulti simt hai, is liye acceleration hamesha origin ki taraf hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
